<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="creatures-of-the-lost-grove" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Creatures of the Lost Grove</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="introduction"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For a creatures of the lost grove task you can choose between three different monsters: Moss Golems, Vinecrawlers and Bulbous crawlers. Moss Golems are the fastest, best xp/hr and best gp/hr, therefore the other ones are only worth doing if you are looking to get a soul.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Cinderbane Gloves </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158355660812.png?v=1" alt="Cinderbanes" title="Cinderbanes" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Drop Rate of 1/1500 on task and 1/5000 off task</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ancient Elven Ritual Shard </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Drop Rate of 1/1500 on task and 1/5000 off task</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Torn Grimoire Pages </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643168594493964298.png?v=1" alt="grimpage" title="grimpage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Drop Rate of 1/512 on task and 1/1536 off task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Creatures of the Lost Grove can be accessed through the monolith west of the incandescent wisp colony, west of Yanille.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The easiest way to get there would be through the fairy ring (code </nowiki><strong><nowiki>B J S</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) after repairing it with 5 Bittercap mushrooms.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An alternative method is to run west from the Incandescent wisp colony, accessible via the portal in the Max guild garden, the elder divination outfit, or via the fairy ring south of Castle Wars (code </nowiki><strong><nowiki>B K P</nowiki></strong><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alternatively, players can also utilise the Solak </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371310891029.png?v=1" alt="solak" title="solak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> boss portal through Max Guild, War's Retreat or the teleport through the grouping system. The exact location for each monster can be found on the map in game.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="moss-golems"><ins><nowiki>Moss Golems</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/zqSNLFE.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Moss Golems have hard hitting melee auto-attacks, and can hit from halberd range. When they lose HP, their heads pop off and spawn a Mossy Rock that also deals damage. To prevent taking too much damage, the Enhanced Devoted </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or cryptbloom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1" alt="cryptbloomhelm" title="cryptbloomhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are extremely important for survivability, as you will be praying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> regardless of which method you are using.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Enhanced Devoted 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on your armour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
